enable_checker_only_saved.description: Turns on only calling the checker on the package being saved.

enable_checker_workspace_diagnostics.description: Turns on running all workspace diagnostics using odin check. This is currently experimental and may cause problems. A better option is using the `checker_path` feature to explicity tell `ols` the projects that it should check. (experimental).

enable_document_symbols.description: Turns on outline of all your global declarations in your document.

enable_unused_imports_reporting.description: Turn on reporting of unused imported packages.

enable_inlay_hints_params.description: Turn on inlay hints for (non-default) parameters.

enable_inlay_hints_default_params.description: Turn on inlay hints for default parameters.

enable_inlay_hints_implicit_return.description: Turn on inlay hints for implicit return values.

enable_inlay_hints_optional_result.description: Adds inlay hints for unhandled optional result value. (#optional_ok and #optional_allocator_error)

enable_procedure_snippet.description: Use snippets when completing procedures—adds parenthesis after the name.

enable_auto_import.description: Automatically import packages that aren't in your import on completion

enable_add_import_to_bottom.description: Add automatically imported packages to bottom of file

enable_references.description: Turns on finding references for a symbol.

enable_document_highlights.description: Turns on highlighting of symbol references in file.

enable_completion_matching.description: Attempt to match types and pointers when passing arguments to procedures.

enable_overload_resolution.description: Enable go-to-definition to resolve overloaded procedures from procedure groups based on call arguments.

enable_comp_lit_signature_help.description: Provide signature help for comp lits such as when instantiating structs. Will not display correctly on some editors such as vscode.

enable_comp_lit_signature_help_use_docs.description: Put signature help for comp lits in the documentation. This will allow it to be rendered nicely using markdown in editors that render the label without colour on one line.

enable_code_action_invert_if.description: Enables the code actions to invert if statements and to rewrite them as early returns.

enable_code_action_extract_variable.description: Enables the code action to extract an expression into a local variable.

enable_code_action_inline_variable.description: Enables the code action to inline a local variable into its uses.

enable_code_action_extract_procedure.description: Enables the code action to extract selected statements into a new procedure.

enable_code_action_add_explicit_type.description: Enables the code action to add the inferred type to a := declaration.

enable_code_action_ternary.description: Enables the code actions converting between an if/else and a ternary expression.

enable_code_action_unwrap.description: Enables the code actions to unwrap a block, if or loop body and to remove a redundant else.

enable_code_action_do_block.description: Enables the code actions converting a one-statement block to a `do` body and back.

enable_code_action_fill_struct.description: Enables the code action filling the missing fields of a struct literal with zero values.

enable_code_action_if_to_switch.description: Enables the code action converting an if/else-if chain of equality tests to a switch.

enable_code_action_result_handling.description: Enables the code actions adding or_return, or_else, an if on the ok/error result, or discarding the results of a call.

enable_code_action_generate_proc.description: Enables the code action generating a stub for a called procedure that does not exist.

enable_code_action_named_results.description: Enables the code action naming the results of a procedure.

enable_inlay_hints_variable_types.description: Turn on inlay hints for inferred variable types.

enable_code_action_split_merge_if.description: Enables the code actions to split an if on && and to merge nested ifs.

enable_code_action_rewrite_expression.description: Enables the code actions to flip a comparison, apply De Morgan's law and convert between compound and plain assignment.

enable_organize_imports_on_save.description: Removes unused imports and adds missing ones on save through workspace/applyEdit.

struct_fields_underscore_visibility.description:
Controls visibility of struct fields starting with `_`:

- "" (default): no hiding; all fields are visible
- "file": hide fields when accessed from outside the declaring file
- "package": hide fields when accessed from outside the declaring package

enable_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostics reported from the lsp.

verbose.description: Logs warnings instead of just errors.

odin_command.description: Specify the location to your Odin executable, rather than relying on the environment path.

odin_root_override.description: Allows you to specify a custom `ODIN_ROOT` that `ols` will use to look for `odin` core libraries when implementing custom runtimes.

enable_checker_vet_shadowing.description: Pass `-vet-shadowing` to `odin check` and report shadowed declarations as warnings.

enable_lint_self_assignment.description: Warn when a variable is assigned to itself.

enable_lint_identical_branches.description: Warn when the if and else branches, or both ternary branches, are identical.

enable_lint_unreachable_code.description: Mark statements after return, break, continue, fallthrough, panic or unreachable as unnecessary.

enable_lint_ignored_result.description: Warn when a call statement discards a bool, union or error result that is not marked optional.

enable_lint_unused_parameter.description: Mark procedure parameters that are never used in the body as unnecessary.

enable_lint_naming.description: Report names that do not follow Odin conventions: snake_case procedures and variables, Ada_Case types and enum members, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants.

enable_lint_unused_declaration.description: On save, mark private declarations that nothing in their package references as unnecessary.

enable_code_lens_references.description: Show a reference count above every top-level declaration.

checker_skip_packages.description: Paths to packages that should not be checked by `odin check` when using `enable_checker_workspace_diagnostics`.

completion_exclude_attributes.description: Filter procedures that include the provided attributes from completions. For example `@(test)`.

profiles.description: List of different profiles that describe the environment ols is running under.

os.description: The operating system for the profile.

checker_path.description: List of paths where to run the checker.

exclude_path.description: List of paths that will be excluded from workspace symbol searches.

defines.description: Key-value pairs of defines. Used for evaluating when expressions, for example `ODIN_DEBUG`. The value must be a string.
